estimates.assumptions: 1 pinch white pepper estimated at ~0.3g (typical for a small pinch of ground spice).
3 tbs total starch (cornstarch) at ~8g per tablespoon; standard density for cornstarch used in marinades and thickening.
3/4 cup chopped onion; standard volume-to-weight conversion for raw chopped onion ~160g per cup, adjusted for typical stir-fry prep.
1/2 cup sliced carrots; standard ~128g per cup for sliced raw carrots, using edible portion only.
3/4 cup chopped green bell pepper; standard ~149g per cup for chopped raw pepper, edible portion.
1 cup chopped celery; standard ~101g per cup for raw chopped celery, fully edible.
1 cup sliced raw mushrooms (button or similar); standard ~70g per cup for sliced fresh mushrooms, fully edible.
